text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... That's strange. I thought I heard 
someone calling me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"...The statue of the Three Goddesses, 
huh. I've heard that the feelings of 
Umamusume who seized glory dwell within 
it, but—"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
When I reach that summit, I wonder what 
kind of view will be waiting for me...?
